name: Thanakorn Srisawat
bio:
Thanakorn's path to motorsport leadership began with a fascination for vehicle dynamics and a passion for engineering. He earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Chulalongkorn University, specializing in automotive design. Following graduation, Thanakorn honed his skills as a data analyst for a small GT racing team, quickly gaining a reputation for his sharp insights and ability to extract meaningful performance gains from complex datasets.

His meticulous approach and collaborative nature led to a promotion to team strategist, where he masterminded race-winning strategies that defied conventional wisdom. Recognizing his potential, Cadillac Racing recruited him as Sporting Director. Thanakorn champions a data-driven approach to race management, constantly seeking innovative solutions to optimize performance and push the boundaries of what's possible. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to inspire his team to achieve peak performance, even in the most challenging circumstances. His management style is 'lead by example'.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Thanakorn is a lean man with a focused gaze and a confident posture.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Prefers green tea over coffee, consuming several cups throughout the day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
